_what: What is done with a listening's heard turns once they are handed in (read-data/what-was-said.mjs). `rename`: the speaker label an unknown voice is written under (a regular expression). `captions`: the ops a caption change can be, and how many captions an answer gives (`last`, at most `most`).

words.rename_needs: Say which listening (`listening`), which voices it heard (`voices`, the enrol tool's heard_as) and the person's name (`name`).
words.needs_listening: Say which listening: `listening` is its name.
words.caption_needs_id: The caption op {op} needs `id`: the heard row it changes.
words.caption_unknown_op: {op} is not a caption op. Ops: {ops}.
words.ask_needs: Say which listening (`listening`) is asked about.
